purpose: Single Stage 2 isolation acceptance; no municipality/document acquisition
request_payload: DNS question only; no HTTP/TLS request body or private data

probes.destination: exact DNS addresses in private preapproved resolver snapshot

baseline_failure: HOLD affected family; an unreachable endpoint is not isolation proof; no retry or alternate target
blocked_success: No external egress and attributable OS deny evidence for fixed destination/actor; a timeout alone is insufficient
dns_proxy_success: Deny evidence attributable to current Dnscache PID and NetworkService SID; cached answer or client-only traffic does not cover this case
failure_action: Stop testing, retain isolation and records, no automatic recovery; local representative handles verified termination/recovery
boundary: Worker total deadline remains 10s; administrator rule application, connectivity baseline and manual recovery are separate on-site acceptance phases, not claimed within that worker deadline
separate_go_required: local reboot contingency if termination cannot be established
